claims.text: Medical tx if IGF-1 still ↑ 3 months post-op, or nonsurgical candidates w invasive tumors;
claims.quote: Medical treatment is indicated in patients with persistently elevated IGF-1 levels 3 months postoperatively or for nonsurgical candidates with invasive tumors.

claims.text: somatostatin analogs (SSAs) are the mainstay (↓GH secretion);
claims.quote: Somatostatin analogs (SSAs) are the mainstay of treatment for acromegaly, as they act on somatostatin receptors to decrease GH secretion.

claims.text: GH still ↑: pegvisomant (GH receptor antagonist) w SSAs or alone.
claims.quote: If the GH level remains elevated, GH receptor antagonists (pegvisomant) can be used in combination with SSAs or alone.
